# cloudraya Provider

Manage CloudRaya infrastructure. The provider exchanges your CloudRaya account e-mail and password for a bearer token, refreshes it before it expires, and sends it on every request.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    cloudraya = {
      source = "cloudraya/cloudraya"
    }
  }
}

# Credentials are read from CLOUDRAYA_EMAIL and CLOUDRAYA_PASSWORD when not set
# here. Prefer the environment variables over committing credentials.
provider "cloudraya" {
  project_id = var.project_id
}

variable "project_id" {
  description = "CloudRaya project to manage resources in."
  type        = string
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `base_url` (String) API host. Defaults to `https://api-v2.cloudraya.com`. May also be set with `CLOUDRAYA_BASE_URL`.
- `email` (String) CloudRaya account e-mail. May also be set with `CLOUDRAYA_EMAIL`.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) CloudRaya account password. May also be set with `CLOUDRAYA_PASSWORD`.
- `project_id` (String) Default project for resources that do not set one. May also be set with `CLOUDRAYA_PROJECT_ID`.
